defect: counter status loses its error bit through a narrowed output
rationale: status_full is five bits and contains the error indicator, but status_o is only four bits, so the status bit is discarded on every assignment.

mutation.description: Reduced the counter status output from five bits to four bits while retaining the error-augmented status value.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the hardened counter's count/error status interface to a combinational status packer.

labels.note: 5-bit status_full truncated to 4-bit status_o losing error bit
